models.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5
models.summary: Anthropic describes Haiku 5.5 as a faster, lower-cost small model for high-volume tasks, priced about 75 percent below Haiku 4.5 on average.

models.headline: Gemini 4 Argon announced for complex reasoning work
models.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for software engineering, knowledge work and cyber defense, rolling out first to trusted testers.

models.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.summary: Anthropic says Sonnet 5.5 runs about 30 percent faster and costs up to 30 percent less than Sonnet 5 for most work.

tools.headline: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission for defenders
tools.summary: The program includes a Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and a free OSS Scanner service to help secure critical infrastructure and open-source software.

tools.headline: Anthropic expands Cyber Verification Program to three tiers
tools.summary: Vetted security professionals get more advanced cyber capabilities and fewer safety blocks, and Project Glasswing and the program are now merged.

tools.headline: Anthropic starts Claude Frontier Academy to train engineers
tools.summary: The $100 million program aims to train 10,000 engineers to deploy Claude in enterprises by the end of 2027, with first cohorts from several large firms.
